received_claims: Primary bounded-self-adjoint Bernstein hypotheses and denominator verified.
Applying both signs yields the2m operator-norm prefactor.
Actual ordinary estimator operator variance<=S_m/tau and centered norm<=R_m/tau.
Exact rational N and log2 cap give per-estimate failure<=beta/(2H).
Conditional independent batches plus adaptive first-failure union are sufficient; no matrix martingale import.
